I'm now a full-fledged user of #TagsPub (after sort-of being a user of it for some time now).  I now have fedi.copyleft.org fully hooked in using the relay interface, & even after 48 hours, I'm seeing a difference in posts for hashtags of interest.

I have to take a moment to urge @evan@cosocial.ca and the #SocialWebFoundation to #GiveUpGithub (maybe for #Codeberg ?).

I can also schedule time in a few months to help you move if you need it!
